# Claude Web Toolkit

> Gamified SEO/GEO audit system for Claude Code. A site-agnostic Growth Optimization
> Framework (12 audit areas, approval-gated consultant flow, file-based SEO-OS state)
> plus a game-style local dashboard ("Command Center") where four robot characters
> level up as tasks complete and merge into Prime at 14/14. Ships real-data bridges:
> Core Web Vitals via the PageSpeed Insights API (incl. CrUX real-user INP) and live
> AI-citation probes against Perplexity / ChatGPT Search / Gemini. MIT licensed;
> zero-dependency pure-Node tools; English + Turkish documentation.

Install inside Claude Code:
`/plugin marketplace add cinfikircom/claude-web-toolkit` then
`/plugin install seo-geo-optimizer@claude-web-toolkit` then `/seo-audit`.

## Key components

- [seo-geo-audit skill](https://github.com/cinfikircom/claude-web-toolkit/blob/main/plugins/seo-geo-optimizer/skills/seo-geo-audit/SKILL.md): the 12-area framework and SEO-OS runtime rules
- [Command Center dashboard](https://github.com/cinfikircom/claude-web-toolkit/blob/main/plugins/seo-geo-optimizer/tools/seo-os-dashboard.js): game-UI benefit panel, localhost:3928 only
- [AI citation probe](https://github.com/cinfikircom/claude-web-toolkit/blob/main/plugins/seo-geo-optimizer/tools/seo-os-probe.js): measures real citations across AI search engines
- [Validation suite](https://github.com/cinfikircom/claude-web-toolkit/blob/main/seo-os-validation-suite/README.md): golden site, fixtures, deterministic 0-100 scorer, judge-consistency harness
